questions.q: What did God create on the first day?
questions.x: God said, Let there be light: and there was light. The sun and moon come on the fourth day.

questions.q: From what did the LORD God form the first man?
questions.x: He formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life.

questions.q: Where did the LORD God plant a garden, eastward?
Who did Eve say beguiled her into eating the fruit?
Who killed his brother Abel?
What sign did God set in the cloud as a token of his covenant after the flood?
questions.x: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.

questions.q: From which city did Terah set out with Abram towards Canaan?
How old was Abram when he departed out of Haran?
Which nephew of Abram chose for himself all the plain of Jordan?
questions.x: Lot chose the well-watered plain and pitched his tent toward Sodom.

questions.q: Who was Sarai's Egyptian handmaid, the mother of Ishmael?
What became of Lot's wife when she looked back towards Sodom?
questions.a: She became a pillar of salt
w: She fell into a deep sleep

questions.q: Which son did God tell Abraham to offer in the land of Moriah?
What did Abraham find caught in a thicket by its horns?
questions.x: He offered the ram for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.

questions.q: Whom did Abraham's servant bring back to be Isaac's wife?
Esau sold his birthright to Jacob for bread and what?
What did Jacob see in his dream at Bethel?
questions.x: The angels of God were ascending and descending on it.

questions.q: For which daughter of Laban did Jacob agree to serve seven years?
What new name was Jacob given after he wrestled until the breaking of the day?
questions.x: For as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.

questions.q: What did Jacob make for Joseph that set his brothers against him?
To which officer of Pharaoh was Joseph sold in Egypt?
What did Pharaoh's dream of seven fat and seven lean kine foretell?
questions.a: Seven years of plenty, then seven of famine

questions.q: What was found in Benjamin's sack?
In which land of Egypt did Jacob's family settle?
Put these in the order Genesis tells them.
Put the generations in order, oldest first.
Match each son to his mother.
Put what God made on the six days in order.
How does Genesis 1 say God brought each thing into being?
questions.x: Again and again: And God said... and it was so.

questions.q: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good.
In whose image did God create man?
questions.x: In the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.

questions.q: What did God promise Abram when he called him?
questions.a: That in him all families of the earth would be blessed
w: That he would be king of Egypt
That he would never grow old

questions.q: Complete the verse.
questions.text: And he [believed] in the LORD; and he counted it to him for [righteousness].
questions.x: Paul builds on this verse in Romans 4: Abraham was counted righteous by faith.

questions.q: What did Hagar call the LORD who spoke to her in the wilderness?
How did God name himself when he appeared to Abram at ninety-nine?
What did Abraham name the place where God provided the ram?
questions.x: The name means 'the LORD will see' or 'provide'.

questions.q: Pleading for Sodom, Abraham asked, 'Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?'
For the sake of how few righteous did God agree not to destroy Sodom?
Joseph to his brothers — complete the verse.
questions.text: But as for you, ye thought [evil] against me; but God meant it unto [good], to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.
questions.x: God works even through the wrong done to Joseph to save many lives.

questions.q: Why did the LORD send the flood?
questions.a: The wickedness of man was great in the earth
w: Men built a tower to heaven

questions.q: After the flood God promised there would never again be a flood to destroy the earth.
When Sarah laughed at the promise of a son, what did the LORD ask?
questions.a: Is any thing too hard for the LORD?
w: Who told thee that thou wast naked?

questions.q: What did God say the woman's seed would do to the serpent?
questions.x: Often called the first promise of the gospel: the serpent bruises his heel, he bruises its head.

questions.q: Jacob wakes at Bethel — complete what he said.
questions.text: Surely the [LORD] is in this place; and I [knew] it not.

questions.q: How many sons did Jacob have?
questions.x: Their descendants become the twelve tribes of Israel.

questions.q: Which king of Salem, priest of the most high God, blessed Abram?
questions.x: Hebrews 7 returns to him as a picture of Christ's priesthood.

questions.q: Who 'walked with God: and he was not; for God took him'?
Of which son did Jacob say, 'The sceptre shall not depart'?
questions.x: David's royal line, and in the end the Messiah, come from Judah.

questions.q: In which cave were Abraham and Sarah buried?
Which two sons of Joseph did Jacob claim as his own?
Joseph asked to be buried in Egypt and his bones were never to be moved.
questions.x: He made the children of Israel swear to carry up his bones from Egypt.
